scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run uvicorn cascade.api:app --reload --port 8620" "npm --workspace frontend run dev"
scripts.generate:types: npm run generate:openapi && npm --workspace frontend run generate:types
scripts.lint: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run ruff check . && npm --workspace frontend run lint
scripts.typecheck: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run mypy src tests && npm --workspace frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: uv --cache-dir .uv-cache run pytest && npm --workspace frontend run test
scripts.build: npm run generate:types && npm --workspace frontend run build
scripts.check: npm run generate:types && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm --workspace frontend run build
